verdict.rationale: Inngest's step.sleep/waitForEvent primitives explicitly checkpoint durable workflows and resume from last successful state without holding a server/connection open, backed by strong docs on durability, retries, and memoization (inngest-docs-2, inngest-docs-18, inngest-docs-21, inngest-docs-16). Community reports independently corroborate reliable long-running background job usage in production (inngest-comm-1, inngest-comm-9). Missing for 10: explicit documented proof of multi-month sleep durations and independent verification of compute/connection release during sleep beyond vendor docs.
